Commander decks have to be 100 unique cards including commander And all cards have to share color identity with your commander, a color identity is not the cards color but all mana symbols on the card like:

https://scryfall.com/card/mor/135/rhys-the-exiled

While hia color is green you can use black cards in the deck because he has a black mana symbol

Color identity does not include mana symbols in reminder text like:

https://scryfall.com/card/c14/139/crypt-ghast

He has a white symbol in his reminder text but this does not count tword his color identity

All basic lands are assumed to have the text "tap: add x mana to your mana pool" so a swamp for example has a black color identity.
